1 - Islam keeps pure monotheism exactly the way every prophet taught it.
No partners, no intermediaries, no confusion. Just God Himself, the same message of Abraham, Moses, and Jesus.
2 - The Qur’an is preserved word-for-word. No editions, no rewrites, no councils voting on what stays or goes. It’s literally the only scripture still in its original language and memorized by millions.
3 - The religion is complete and practical. Islam doesn’t just tell you what to believe, it tells you how to live, how to worship, how to treat people, how to purify your heart, how to build a healthy society. It’s a full blueprint, not just a belief system.
It matches both spirituality and logic.
4 - You don’t have to shut off your brain to follow it. The theology actually makes sense, the rules have wisdom, and it lines up with human nature.
5 - Every other scripture confirms a final messenger was meant to come.
Islam doesn’t cancel previous prophets, it completes their message.
